prompt: Figma just shipped an AI agent that designs whole screens from a prompt. we're a design tool aimed at people who aren't designers. riff on this with me
expected_output: A multi-angle strategic read of the launch — what it signals, who it threatens, what it opens — not a feature comparison or a generic SWOT.
assertions: Reads the launch from several distinct strategic angles rather than one

Distinguishes what actually changed from what is merely announced
